placement_findings.reason: Original parent covers CDs, production capacity and household objects. Goto’s controller shapes and the dated 2024 industrial-identity objects add concrete material. First lid image partly echoes the existing opener but does not duplicate four-card argument.
Original two-section parent introduces dock/Joy-Con. New early announcement detail and 2021 circuit/hinge/strength packaging decisions add substantial content, rather than another launch summary.

Original five-section DS source already covers split information, touch and social use. New primary 2004 imagined football example and later DSi XL paper/manufacturing/furniture decisions are additive. No touch claim is falsely sourced to the 2004 interview.

Original source already covers hub, co-design and packaging. New Copilot evolution, tactile port/mount details and Sony test-led comparison add specifics. factual_checks: Sony Part 3 supports circular drive, rectangular body, grips and Goto icons; independently reopened current official text while direct HTTP 403 remains recorded honestly.
Nishino announcement dated 19 September 2024 supports old colour scheme and actual cable-connector housing/shapes ties. No announced November release is passed as newly verified shipment.
Switch 20 October 2016 announcement genuinely describes dock, train/apartment and Joy-Con hand/grip arrangements; not a 2016 retail launch.
Nintendo 12 October 2021 OLED interview supports Shiota film folding, Yamashita thin display/metal stand/large hinges, 3 mm width, unchanged height/thickness and dock/Joy-Con constraint.

Japan Spotlight July/August 2004 printed p25 states the football two-view example as future DS intention; p23 complexity and p25 advanced-technology remarks were read. PDF p3 rendered and visually inspected.
DSi XL chapter 2 supports cut card, 4.2-inch LCD panel yield, side viewing, furniture research and tabletop family use. Same interview chapter 1 was also opened for role/context checking.

Microsoft StoryLabs supports 2014 photo to 2015 hackathon chain, Copilot standalone decision, 19 ports, embossed symbols/grooves and three threaded mounting inserts. Source raw metadata says 16 May 2018.

Alvin Daniel 12 October 2023 account supports two participants with same diagnosis/different needs, coplanar larger buttons, cap variations, paired controllers/stick placement and all three named partner organisations.
same_publication_grouping: All sections/participants of each interview count together. Eight distinct primary publications. Date/name cross-checking within DSi XL does not create a ninth group.
limits: Word charges are for these newly authored feature texts. This review does not recalculate derivation for every inherited parent paragraph or certify historical source text is copyright-cleared.
Manufacturer memories and intent are attributed; no hardware measurements or runtime benchmark was performed.
No media selected or rights cleared. A photograph or source URL is not an illustration-readiness test.
English source prose/locales, master, assembler, runtime, build and console were not modified by this review.

approved_revision_verification.method: Reverse the two approved opening changes and compare all four complete body-array hashes against the initial review receipt. All original source snapshots still match; full-visible word charges independently recomputed.
